title: spec(automation): ConnectorConnectionState.redirectUri TSDoc still says "declared ahead of the service that answers it" now that the service sets it
body:
domain:server#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXsK9j25sd7eVwW96G

Filing gate: ① an out-of-scope finding (class b, stale published prose) of the #29463 dev (os-dev-report 6593592295), carrier `domain:spec`, filed at the seat's ACCEPT of PR #29701. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p3.

**Business reason.** `packages/spec` docblocks ship in `dist` and generate the API reference. Once PR #29701 lands, the automation service sets `redirectUri` on every connection read that can derive it. The spec still tells an implementer that no answer carries it, so an AI or a human writing a client against the contract would code a fallback for a key that is always served when a base exists.

## What is stale

- `packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts`, the `ConnectorConnectionState.redirectUri` TSDoc ends: "Declared ahead of the service that answers it: until the automation service sets it, no answer carries it." Spec seat note 6590124337 (on #29463) asked that this sentence name the producer once it exists, as `approval-service.ts` names its producer.
- The pending changeset `.changeset/29574-connector-redirect-uri.md` carries the same bullet ("**Declared ahead of the service.** … until the automation service sets the key, no answer carries it"). If #29574 and #29463 ship in the same release, that release note contradicts itself. Editing another PR's pending changeset is a deliberate changeset correction, which the gate requires a human to confirm.

## Wanted

- Replace the sentence with one naming the producer: `AutomationServicePlugin.getConnectorConnection` (`packages/services/service-automation/src/plugin.ts`) sets it whenever the derivation has a base. Regenerate any reference page the docblock feeds.
- Changeset: either correct the #29574 bullet (with the human confirmation the gate requires), or leave it and let the #29463 changeset's text carry the truth. The spec seat decides and says which.

Serial: after PR #29701 (#29463).

Dedupe: searched `redirectUri declared ahead`, `ConnectorConnectionState redirectUri`. The nearest are #29574 (the declaration, closed) and #29463 (the producer). **New.**

Links back: #29463, PR #29701, #29574, PR #29618.
